reason: Both int4-g128 trials retained 100% of BF16 quality and exceeded the 95% throughput target. It is the only measured recipe that meets both gates. Its 2,299 MiB peak is the current evidence-backed memory floor among recipes that pass; lower-memory recipes did not meet the quality gate.
risk: No heldout tasks were measured. The two throughput results differ, and peak MLX memory may vary. This is a hypothesis for the next measurement block, not proof of heldout quality or minimum possible memory.
